header: The logo and a statement on one side, a sign-up prompt on the other
text: The second half is the prompt, not the form: the button leads to the sign-up page, so this band never collects an address and never has to obtain consent.
note: The frequency and unsubscribe sentence lives here, where an editor can keep it true. The toggle swaps the two halves; below 768px they stack, copy first.
